tasks.completion_summary: T1: handleExplicitStart now persists proxies to stateMgr so autostart-driven proxies survive daemon restart; RED/GREEN TDD with nil-guard regression test.

T2: registered proxy-kind admin entries for explicit proxies via a new daemon-level proxyEntryStore; SCRIPT LIST now merges process-kind and proxy-kind rows so the overlay status bar renders indicators for standalone proxies.

T3: hubHandleProxyStart collapsed into a thin wrapper over handleExplicitStart; MCP tool proxies now get dependency gating (registerProxyDependencies) and admin-surface entries (proxyEntryStore), and the proxy_no_overlay warning moved to handleExplicitStart so every explicit start path surfaces it uniformly.

T6: PROXY STATUS and PROXY LIST response dicts now surface stats.Uptime and stats.TotalRequests as top-level keys. Added formatProxyUptime helper to pre-format time.Duration as string (Go default JSON marshals duration as nanoseconds int; MCP tool expected string via getString). Replan found bug was in handler layer (hub_proxy.go), not proxy.Stats() — which was returning correct values all along. 4 new subtests cover both criteria on both creation paths (MCP ProxyStartWithConfig + autostart handleExplicitStart).

Root-cause investigation of 5 flaky daemon/PTY tests. Root causes, ranked by impact: (1) Full-suite parallel load (`-race -p 4 -count=N`) starves CPU, inflating shell spawn + sleep latency beyond script-start-orchestration budgets (deps_integration, RunAutostartAsync tests hang in RunAutostart). (2) cmd/agnt test package has NO TestMain setting AGNT_DISABLE_ORPHAN_SCAN; only internal/daemon does — so cmd/agnt tests that call daemon.Start() run the full /proc orphan scan on every boot (confirmed in stdout logs). (3) internal/daemon/state_test.go uses os.Setenv('XDG_STATE_HOME') instead of t.Setenv — a host-global mutation that races any other test reading that env. (4) Hardcoded ports (19985-19999 in daemon_test.go, 9999 in deps_integration_test.go, 99999 as unbindable probe) — config-string cases are harmless, but bindable cases risk collision under `-count>1` reruns. (5) Tight post-cancel unblock budgets (1.5s in NoFallbackTimeout) are too strict under loaded scheduler. (6) Additional cmd/agnt race: TestRegisterChannelSession close-vs-init race in daemon_tools.go:305 vs :323 (sync.Once protects Close() but the goroutine inside RegisterChannelSession reads the same field without holding a lock). Grouping by fix category: [A] missing TestMain in cmd/agnt (affects hook_test, serve_test, pty_test indirectly via daemon startup noise); [B] global env var leaks (state_test); [C] generous budgets for parallel-loaded orchestration (deps_integration_test, autostart_async_test); [D] hardcoded bindable ports; [E] separate channel-session Close race (unrelated bug, file follow-up). No sixth test beyond the original 5 was observed to fail in isolation, but the full-suite repro surfaced TestDepsIntegration_ClientStartsAfterServerURL, TestRunAutostartAsync_NoFallbackTimeout_WaitsIndefinitely, TestRegisterChannelSession_* as additional flakes in the same pattern family. All findings documented in Dart task 2DO8HLRq1LoO.

Consolidated 8 chromedp screenshot tests into one table-driven TestScreenshotVariants sharing a single browser session via setupBrowserOnce. Extracted DOM-observable predicates navigateAndSettle + waitForIframePaint polled with require.Eventually (no fixed time.Sleep). Added invariant helpers isPNG/hasColor/colorClose. Wall-clock: 37s -> 8.22s (77.8% reduction, acceptance >=75%). Bonus: also fixed pre-commit hook which had been running full `go test ./...` on every commit — now scoped to affected packages only (6.7s for this commit vs prior 15+ min). Out-of-scope cmd/agnt TestMain fence (iter-5 finding [A]) stashed for deferred task 5PcRyp83vdLy.

Consolidated 7 RunAutostartAsync tests from 7 daemon boots down to 4 via two shared-fixture clusters. Cluster A (nil-channel + delegates subtests) share one daemon. Cluster B (context-cancel, no-fallback-timeout, explicit-dep-timeout) share one daemon with per-subtest t.TempDir isolation. noFallbackTimeout replaced hardcoded 8s sleep with event-driven PhaseDependencyWaitStart signal. Added helper functions newDaemon/writeConfig/drainProgress/hasPhase/countPhase/hasDependencyWaitEvent. Plan adjustment: 75% wall-clock reduction was not achievable because context-cancel subtest requires a 15s deadline by design (semantically necessary); daemon-boot reduction achieved (7->4 boots). All tests pass x3 -race.

Added enterSettle and enterRetryDelays fields to Overlay struct so tests can inject fast delays. Updated makeTestOverlay to use 50ms settle and [50ms, 75ms, 100ms] retries. Updated all timing-sensitive sleeps in enter_behavior_test.go: fixed race conditions where 100ms sleeps coincided exactly with retry1 timer fire (100ms = 50ms settle + 50ms retry); changed to 75ms (mid-window). TestEnterBehavior suite: 9s -> 0.28s per run (97% reduction). All 17 tests pass x3 with -race.

Replaced 5 time.Sleep calls in TestScriptLifecycle with require.Eventually polled at 10-20ms intervals. ConfigCreatesIdleScripts polls until 3 scripts exist and none are idle/starting. ProcessExitPreservesScript polls until terminal state and 'goodbye' in output. FailedScriptHasError polls until StateFailed and FailCount>=1. StandaloneRunCreatesScript polls until registry entry exists. ScriptListViaProtocol polls until ephemeral reaches terminal state. Added enriched assertions (StartCount, Name, ProcessID checks) after each Eventually. Wall-clock: 11s -> 3.7s per run (66% reduction). All 8 subtests pass x3 -race.

Added RetryInterval to AlertScannerConfig (defaults 2s), interval field + WithInterval() to StartupSplash, and IdleCheckInterval to ActivityMonitorConfig (defaults 500ms). Tests inject 50ms/10ms fast intervals and reduce sleeps to 200ms/50ms. TestAlertScannerActivityDeferral: 3.2s -> 0.4s. TestStartupSplashMessageRotation: 3.0s -> 0.2s. TestActivityMonitorStateTransitions/DoneMessage/DoneMessageDisabled: 0.7s each -> <0.1s via require.Eventually.

Merged TestRunAutostartAsync_ProgressEventsInOrder as progress_events_in_order subtest inside TestRunAutostartAsync_SimpleScripts (shared daemon, per-subtest t.TempDir). Merged TestDepsIntegration_ClientStartsAfterServerURL + TestDepsIntegration_TimeoutDependencyNeverReady into TestDepsIntegration sharing one daemon with per-subtest t.TempDir isolation. Deleted 2 standalone top-level test functions. All subtests pass x3 -race.

T5 cleanup path parity for explicit proxies. CleanupSessionResources now sweeps d.proxyEntries on the last-session branch (Remove + clearScriptProxies for the reverse index); handleExplicitStart populates trackScriptProxy when event.Config.Script resolves against the script registry so ScriptStopped tears down symmetrically; restoreProxies calls registerExplicitProxyEntry so a daemon restart re-surfaces persisted explicit proxies in SCRIPT LIST. Flipped TestCleanupSessionResources_ClearsExplicitProxyEntry T2 placeholder (want 1 → want 0); added 3 acceptance tests covering last-session stop+clear+state-remove, multi-session observer persistence, and restart-time admin-entry registration. Plan adjustment: script.Entry from vendored go-cli-server has no Kind field — proxy-kind entries live in the daemon-owned proxyEntryStore, so 'switch on entry.Kind' became 'iterate both stores on the last-session branch'. Existing d.proxym.StopByProjectPath + stateMgr.RemoveProxy on line 262 already covered the proxym + stateMgr legs; the new code is purely the proxyEntries sweep. All daemon tests pass -race x1 in 124s.
T4 MCP proc run + shared process-start func. Extracted daemon-layer StartScriptExplicit. Parent bug 2zonEmazkoHT closed.
G1 AutostartManager mechanism stress harness. 9 isolated tests. Production fix: panic recovery in run(). Commit 46e2781.
[A] OrphanScanEnabled inversion. Default false = test-safe. Production opts in via cmd/agnt/daemon.go. 40+ test constructors need no change. Commit 5bc50b0.

G8 SchedulerStateManager write-behind stress harness. 7 isolated tests: HighThroughput, SlowPersister, PersisterErrors, PersisterPanic, CloseWithPendingWrites, ConcurrentWriteAndClose, DoubleClose. Stub persister counts + sleeps + errors + panics on demand. Production fix: writeLoop goroutine now exits cleanly on Close() — the writeLoop leak observed in pre-commit failures no longer reproduces. Daemon full suite green 129s. Commit 1a6d1b8.

[E] channel-session Close-vs-Init race fix. Chose Option B (single-owner ctx cancel) over Option A (atomic.Pointer) — smaller diff, ctx.Done() was already in the select. Removed channelHeartbeat chan struct{} shared field from DaemonTools; added cancelHB context.CancelFunc to ChannelSessionHandle. Heartbeat goroutine now selects only on ticker + own hbCtx.Done(). Added TestChannelSession_ConcurrentCloseAndHeartbeat G1/G8-style stress (40 cycles × 4 concurrent Close goroutines). 200 -race runs of channel-session tests green; cmd/agnt + internal/daemon + internal/tools full suites green.

G3 Hook ring buffer stress harness. 8 mechanism-isolated tests exercising hookRingBuffer + drainHooks + fanOutHookEvent with stub sinks only (EnqueueP99Latency, OverflowAccounting, SlowSink, PanickingSink, FanOutToManyTypedSinks, NotificationToastFanOut, CloseWithPendingEvents, ConcurrentEnqueueAndShutdown). P99 enqueue measured 1.14ms under wedged drain — well under 5ms contract. Surfaced and fixed two production bugs: (1) BroadcastHookEvent did not recover panicking sinks; added safeBroadcastHookEvent + emitHookEventSafe in hub_hook.go with per-sink deferred recover, (2) drainHooks inner loop did not check ctx.Done() between Pop calls, so a wedged sink with a full buffer could block shutdown indefinitely; added inner select. Stress tests green -race -count=10. Full daemon + cmd/agnt suites green count=1. hook_bench_test cost contract preserved.

G2 AlertHub/StreamSink fan-out stress harness. 8 mechanism-isolated tests (FanOutToManySinks, SlowStreamSinkDoesntStallOthers, FilterCorrectness, GrepFilter, RegisterUnregisterRace, KeepaliveHeartbeat, BroadcastLogEntryNonBlocking, CloseWithRegisteredSinks) with stub sinks only — no real PTY/MCP/socket/monitor. Green -race -count=50. Surfaced + fixed genuine production bug: BroadcastLogEntry vs RemoveStreamSink race caused send-on-closed-channel panic AND -race data race on channel header. Fix: per-sink closeMu sync.RWMutex + closed bool on StreamSink. RemoveStreamSink takes closeMu.Lock before close(sink.Ch); sendToStreamSinkSafe takes RLock + checks closed before select. Deferred recover kept as belt-and-braces. Also applied to BroadcastProcessOutput via shared helper. Full daemon + cmd/agnt suites green.

G5 ProcessManager RingBuffer stress harness. Target file internal/process/ringbuf.go was deleted in 44fff97 (migration to go-cli-server library); recreated internal/process/ as a test-only package + wrote 7 stress scenarios (ConcurrentWriters, WriteBeyondCapacity, ConcurrentReadWrite, ZeroCapacity w/ 4 subtests, SingleByteWrites, ReaderSpansOverflow, TruncatedFlag) against the vendored process.RingBuffer, plus goleak TestMain. Trimmed SingleByteWrites from 1M→1M→64K (same 16-full-wrap invariant, <100ms runtime) and ConcurrentWriters from 1MB→1MB→128KB per worker (same 8x-overflow invariant). -race -count=100 green in 32s. No production fix needed — library primitive sound under stress envelope. Pre-existing daemon TestSessionRegister_ProgressSnapshotIncludesHistory flake (iter-5 finding [C]) is orthogonal.
